subject: Sentinel AI renewal: capacity trajectory & proposed reserved pool
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@sentinelai.com>; Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@sentinelai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff — QPS/token trajectory & data request

Hi Samantha / Liam,

Thanks for confirming the renewal window. To make a concrete sizing recommendation for Dedicated capacity and a reserved pool for production, we need a short data snapshot and a few clarifying items from your side: 

1) Hourly peak QPS for the last 90 days (approx) and percentile targets you want to guarantee (p50/p95/p99).
2) Monthly token consumption (in millions) for Q1 and Q2 2027 and the top-3 model variants in use.
3) % of requests that require long context (>2k tokens) or streaming responses.
4) Any expected product launches or sales campaigns in next 6 months that could drive step-changes.

If you can send the CSV export (template attached) I’ll model a capacity trajectory and propose a reserved pool (GPU count & headroom) plus a throughput SLA we can include in the renewal term.

Initial ask from our side: is Sentinel open to a 24-month term that includes 30% headroom over forecasted p95 QPS and an optional 3-month burst pool for product launches? That structure helps keep unit cost lower while protecting availability.

Attaching a simple usage template to fill — will whip up a sizing doc once we have the numbers.

Best,
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sentinel_usage_template.csv (CSV, 6KB)]

From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@sentinelai.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@sentinelai.com>, procurement@sentinelai.com
Date: 2027-04-28T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — QPS/token trajectory & data request

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks — attaching the Q1/Q2 export and a short note on our roadmap. Highlights:
- Q1 peak p95 QPS: 1,450 (weekdays, 10:00–12:00 PT)
- Q2 current p95 QPS: 1,780 with growth driven by new multi-user feature launched late March
- Token consumption: Q1=420M, Q2=610M (projection includes new feature usage)
- ~18% requests use streaming; ~12% long-context (>2k tokens)
- We expect two marketing pushes (May and Sept) that could add short spikes of ~20–25% for 2–4 weeks.

See attached CSV (sentinel_usage_q1_q2.csv). We are open to a 24-month term but would like to see an upfront cost vs. headroom trade-off. Also include recommended guardrails for long-context requests — those are driving latency for us.

Cheers,
Samantha
Samantha Cho
Head of Platform, Sentinel AI
[Attachment: sentinel_usage_q1_q2.csv (CSV, 42KB)]

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Renewal kickoff — capacity inputs from Sentinel (analysis + recommended ask)

Team — forwarding Sentinel's usage. Quick analysis + recommendation below (keeping it short):

Quoted:
> Q1 peak p95 QPS: 1,450
> Q2 current p95 QPS: 1,780
> Token consumption: Q1=420M, Q2=610M
> Streaming: 18% | Long-context: 12%
> 20–25% marketing spikes expected

Modeling notes (assumptions):
- Baseline growth: linear from Q2 usage -> project +22% QoQ conservatively across next 4 quarters unless product-driven step-change.
- Peak-to-average ratio: use historical Sentinel shape -> p95 ~ 2.8x average QPS.
- Long-context requests increase per-token GPU occupancy by ~2.2x on H100-equivalent provisioning.

Sizing outputs (proposal):
- Recommended reserved pool: 14 x H100-equivalent GPUs (serving runtime configured with batching and prefix cache). Rationale: supports projected p99 runway through next 12 months with 30% headroom at p95 during normal weeks and ability to attach 4-GPU burst pool during marketing spikes.
- Alternative lower-cost option: 10 x H100-equivalent GPUs + a paid burst pool (6 GPUs on-demand for spikes). This reduces commit but raises per-token unit price ~18%.
- Throughput SLA proposal: guaranteed p95 latency target with capacity-backed QPS: commit to p95 latency for model variant rwd-2-large at up to 2,400 QPS sustained (with autoscale constraints) and explicit fallback to smaller variants beyond that. Include a 3% credit for any monthly p95 breach beyond 2 consecutive months.
- Long-context mitigation: enable selective KV prefix caching and rate-limit long-context sessions to a concurrency cap; recommend a separate long-context node-pool (2 GPUs) to offload heavy sessions — we can make that optional add-on.

Pricing/term framing to propose to customer:
- 24-month term with two tiers: (A) 14 GPU reserved pool + 4-GPU burst (preferred) — lower unit price; (B) 10 GPU reserved + on-demand burst — mid price. Include a 30% headroom commitment for p95 and an option to re-evaluate at 12 months.

Docs to attach: proposed_sizing_v3.pdf (contains charts + cost table) and standard term sheet (redwood-dedicated-terms.docx).

Next steps: approve the specific GPU counts and SLA language and I’ll send a single-sheet to Sentinel with the two options and an estimated monthly unit cost delta. Marissa — can you sanity-check the SLA credit language? Priyom — confirm the feasibility and whether 14 H100-equivalents aligns with capacity availability for July start.

Thanks,
Nikhil

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@sentinelai.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@sentinelai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priom@redwood.com>, procurement@sentinelai.com, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Sentinel renewal — two-tier reserved pool options (attach: sizing + terms)

Hi Samantha & Liam,

Great to sync — based on your CSV and expected campaign spikes we propose two options for the renewal (summary below; full details attached):

Option A (Preferred): 24-month term | 14 H100-equivalent reserved GPUs + 4-GPU burst pool
- Coverage: Supports projected p99 runway for next 12 months and provides ~30% headroom at p95.
- Long-context handling: include a small dedicated long-context node pool (2 GPUs) to keep tail latency predictable.
- SLA: p95 latency guarantee for rwd-2-large up to sustained 2,400 QPS; monthly credits (3%) for breaches beyond 2 consecutive months.
- Pricing: blended unit rate (tokens) with ~22% discount vs month-to-month baseline.

Option B (Lower commit): 24-month term | 10 H100-equivalent reserved GPUs + on-demand burst (6 GPUs)
- Coverage: Good for steady growth; requires on-demand burst for campaign spikes.
- Pricing: higher unit token rate (~+18% vs Option A) but lower committed monthly spend.

We attached proposed_sizing_v3.pdf (charts & cost scenarios) and redwood-dedicated-terms.docx (term sheet). If you prefer, we can also include a clause to re-evaluate at month 12 for a one-time adjustment (no penalties) if actual p95 exceeds our forecast by >25%.

Next steps:
1) Let us know which option you prefer and any changes to the SLA credit formula.
2) If Option A, procurement can expect a DocuSign link for the term sheet and PO instructions (link below).
3) We’ll schedule a 30-min handoff with our onboarding/infra team for provisioning timelines once signature is in.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8791
DocuSign (preview): https://docusign.com/embedded/abc123-sentinel
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SENTINELRENEWAL

Thanks again — happy to jump on a call to walk through sizing.

Regards,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
